name: jgb_yield_curve
description: Japan government bond (JGB) yield curve for one day: all 15 benchmark tenors (1Y-10Y, 15Y, 20Y, 25Y, 30Y, 40Y) in percent, from the Ministry of Finance Japan. Omit date for the latest business day. A weekend or holiday returns found:false with the nearest published days.

date.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD (business days only). Default: latest.

name: jgb_yield_history
description: History of one JGB yield tenor (e.g. 10Y, 30Y) over a date range, oldest first, in percent, from the Ministry of Finance Japan. Daily back to 1974 (long tenors from their first issuance). Default range: the last 90 days.

from.description: ISO start date YYYY-MM-DD. Default: 90 days before the end.

to.description: ISO end date YYYY-MM-DD. Default: latest.

limit.description: Max rows (default 500, max 2000); the most recent rows are kept.
